§ 51-9.303-4 Denials of access.
§ 51-9.303-4 Denials of access.
(a) The Executive Director may deny any individual access to his record only on the grounds that the Committee has published rules in the 
Federal Register
(b) Upon receipt of a request for access to an exempt system, the Executive Director shall prepare a letter denying access. The letter of denial shall contain a justification for denial of access which includes appropriate citation to the exemption provisions of these rules or other 
Federal Register
